ref_entities: create a MiniGridEnv subclass and implement _gen_grid to build a custom 2D grid world environment
step the agent forward in the grid environment using env.step(action) to get observation and reward
encode the grid into a compact numpy array using Grid.encode() for serialization or observation generation
decode a numpy array back into a Grid object using Grid.decode() to reconstruct the environment state
render the grid environment visually using env.render(mode='human') to display the agent and grid tiles
register a new MiniGrid environment with OpenAI gym using a custom entry point and reward threshold
register a MiniGrid environment with the default reward threshold of 0.95
review the register function to understand how MiniGrid environments are added to the gym registry
summarize the env_list module variable that tracks all registered MiniGrid environment IDs
test the register function to confirm it raises an assertion error when registering a duplicate environment ID
downsample a numpy image array along both dimensions by a given integer factor using mean pooling
fill pixels of a numpy image with a color where coordinates match a filter function like a circle or line
rotate a coordinate filter function around a center point by a given theta angle in radians
create a predicate function that tests if a point lies inside a line, circle, rectangle, or triangle
add a semi-transparent color highlight overlay to a numpy image array with configurable alpha blend
create a RoomGrid environment with configurable room size, rows, and columns for multi-room Minigrid tasks
add a door connecting two adjacent rooms in the RoomGrid with optional color and locked state
place a key, ball, or box object into a specific room by grid index using add_object
ensure all rooms in the RoomGrid are reachable from the agent starting position by adding doors
remove a wall between two adjacent rooms to create an open passage with no door
create a Window instance with a title to draw a gridworld using Matplotlib
show or update an image in the Window using the show_img method with a numpy array
set or update the caption text below the image using the set_caption method
register a keyboard event handler callback function using the reg_key_handler method
show the Window and start the event loop using the show method with optional blocking
create an ActionBonus wrapper to add exploration rewards for less visited state-action pairs in a gym environment
create a StateBonus wrapper to add exploration rewards based on visited grid positions in a gym environment
create a FullyObsWrapper to give the agent a fully observable compact grid encoding of the entire environment
create a ViewSizeWrapper to customize the agent field of view size for a partially observable gym environment
create a DirectionObsWrapper to provide slope or angular direction to the goal in observations
